paragraphs: Four Explorers, posted by Lily. Teacher Kim asked me to write about the club for new visitors to the blog. Each Explorer has a job, and each Explorer has a different character. We meet every Thursday in the school library. Our club sign is a paw print on a green flag. Here are four of us. I start with myself.

I am the blog editor, and I like writing. I write a diary every night before I sleep. I notice small details, so I am good at checking posts. My notebook is blue, and my pen is always in my bag. I do not like to be late. I am helpful, but sometimes I am too careful. Afterwards, I always read every post twice.

Mia takes the photos and writes the animal fact files. She loves nature and wild animals. Her white kitten, Snow, sits on her desk when she writes. She wants to visit the coast one day and see the sea birds. Mia is kind and quiet, but she talks a lot about animals. She takes photos of birds in the park every Sunday. She can explain a fact clearly, and everybody listens.

Leo draws the cartoons and makes the posters. He likes camping, and he wants to sleep in a tent on the beach. Leo is funny, and he loves silly stories. He tells a silly story first, and afterwards he tells a fact. Sometimes the story is bad, but we always laugh. Leo wears silly socks, and nobody is surprised. He explains his cartoons with a big smile.

May writes the emails and asks the questions to visitors. She likes English, and she writes to our pen pals. She tries a new word every day. May is brave and friendly, so she is never afraid to ask a question. On Thursday, she serves the juice at the club. "Would you like some more?" she asks every child. I am happy that these three are my friends. Together, we are a good team, because we are all different. Which Explorer are you like?
text.summary: Lily writes a page for Explorers' Blog about four members of the club. For each child, the page says what the child likes and what the child is like.
